sections.section_title: EXTI CPU wake-up with event mask register (EXTI_EMR1)
sections.text_helper: Section 16.6.18 "EXTI CPU wake-up with event mask register (EXTI_EMR1)" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 468.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x084
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 EMx: CPU wake-up with event generation mask on event input x (x = 31 to 0)
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIVx is disabled, EMx can be accessed with privileged and
unprivileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIVx is enabled, EMx can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this bit is discarded.
0: Wake-up with event generation from Line x is masked.
1: Wake-up with event generation from Line x is unmasked.
